invariants.name: No Unexplained Disconnection
invariants.description: If a baseline journey was connected for an accessibility profile, the candidate must remain connected unless an explicit infrastructure closure event is attached.

invariants.name: No Forbidden Edge Traversal
invariants.description: A candidate route must never traverse edges that violate the physical constraints of the selected mobility profile (e.g. stairs for step_free).

invariants.name: Deterministic Tie-Breaking
invariants.description: Equal-cost paths must always resolve identically across runs using stable lexicographic tie-breaking on edge identifiers.

invariants.name: Complete Route Attributes
invariants.description: Every active edge in a candidate path must supply valid length, slope, surface, and width attributes. No silent fallback to unvalidated defaults.
